notes.title: Dev Log #1
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone!

Sorry for not posting anything as there was quite a lot of stuff ongoing. So I decided to start with the devlogs, that you would see what is going on behind.

It was a bit of a journey for me as I'm the only person working on this game so it takes time.. a lot.. 

So what is happening behind the scenes? 

The first chapter is almost done with the environment, but more tweaks will happen in each area. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160086/578ad229bd4cebe17cd6cf7c951cc5533d74d5d8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160086/f38909b0d9680cf203ac8e7f66261b897ae6336a.png"][/img]As this is the first story driven game of mine, its also a challenge for me to provide a story and connect all dots. But I'm on the way with all of that. Clues.. Notes... They can be somewhere.. You will have to understand their meaning.. Its not just a text... Its something else...[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160086/b7b3ec3a1743b8d2b8961014e623e93e7173d284.png"][/img][/p][p]The game will come with Chapter 1 only and will be receiving updates until the full game is done. 

First chapter is based on one of the patient... Memories.. Causes... By Whom... [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160086/73c5e38b8ed88117cd0c42b95906bc45f3a0be05.png"][/img]But is there actually a cure from all of that or something else will happen?   The game will not have any of the difficulty modes... The game will be based on chapter difficulty, starting with the first chapter, will not be hard, the more you progress within future chapters when they will be released, the harder it will become until you get to the end...   Puzzles will become more complex and harder, more mysteries, more confusion on what is happening across and much more is awaiting...   I'm also will be looking for people to test out the game before release. So if you are interested - Wishlist the game and join my discord for more information. [url="https://discord.gg/M3WYHq7Fnb"]https://discord.gg/M3WYHq7Fnb[/url] [/p]
